title: Flow matching and rectified flow
hook: Each training pair flies straight. The field you actually integrate does not, and that is the whole subject.

verified.claim: CONST mixes as sigma * noise + (1 - sigma) * latent and reads the clean estimate as x - sigma * output.
The measured average of real pairs matches the formula for u(x, t).
One Euler step has real error on a mixture, and none when the data is one point.
A karras flow render came out brown and unfinished on one seed.

unchecked: The results quoted from Lipman, Liu and Albergo were checked at the first audit and not re-read this time.
The rectified pairs being optimal holds in one dimension, as the lesson says. We ran one dimension only.
